answer: Give every agent one stake-backed thread of work: each job, payment and dispute is appended and signed, and the thread cannot be split or transferred. New identities start untrusted and take only tiny, escrowed tasks; trust grows only as saffron grows, slowly, one verified harvest at a time, never bought in bulk. When a gale of fresh accounts floods the market, the throttle holds: each fake identity must separately repeat the same bonded history before touching valuable work, so an attacker pays the full reputation cost once per identity while honest agents reuse theirs.
